base1.effect: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

base1.name: Machop
base1.effect: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

base1.name: Magnemite
base1.effect: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

base1.name: Metapod
base1.effect: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

base1.name: Nidoran ♂
base1.effect: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

base1.name: Onix
base1.effect: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

base1.name: Pidgey
base1.effect: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

base1.name: Pikachu
base1.effect: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

base1.name: Poliwag
base1.effect: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

base1.name: Ponyta
base1.effect: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

base1.name: Rattata
base1.effect: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

base1.name: Sandshrew
base1.effect: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

base1.name: Squirtle
base1.effect: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

base1.name: Starmie
base1.effect: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

base1.name: Staryu
base1.effect: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

base1.name: Tangela
base1.effect: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

base1.name: Voltorb

base1.name: Vulpix

base1.name: Weedle
base1.effect: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

base1.name: Clefairy Doll
base1.effect: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts a a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). base1.name: Computer Search
base1.effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

base1.name: Devolution Spray
base1.effect: Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. base1.name: Impostor Professor Oak
base1.effect: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

base1.name: Item Finder
base1.effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

base1.name: Lass
base1.effect: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

base1.name: Pokémon Breeder
base1.effect: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

base1.name: Pokémon Trader
base1.effect: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

base1.name: Scoop Up
base1.effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

base1.name: Super Energy Removal
base1.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

base1.name: Defender
base1.effect: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

base1.name: Energy Retrieval
base1.effect: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

base1.name: Full Heal
base1.effect: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

base1.name: Maintenance
base1.effect: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

base1.name: PlusPower
base1.effect: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

base1.name: Pokémon Center
base1.effect: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

base1.name: Pokémon Flute
base1.effect: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

base1.name: Pokédex
base1.effect: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

base1.name: Professor Oak
base1.effect: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

base1.name: Revive
base1.effect: Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

base1.name: Super Potion
base1.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

base1.name: Bill
base1.effect: Draw 2 cards.

base1.name: Energy Removal
base1.effect: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

base1.name: Gust of Wind
base1.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

base1.name: Potion
base1.effect: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

base1.name: Switch
base1.effect: Switch 1 of your own Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

base1.effect:
